canonical_name: Creative-set definition, existence, and property family
statement_blocker: The catalog says only 'properties of creative sets'. Post's inspected 1944 section contains a definition, an existence theorem, closure observations, nonrecursiveness and undecidability consequences, a complement-infinitude consequence, and adjacent completeness results. The catalog supplies no proposition locator or indication which claim is intended. Choosing one, conjoining several, or silently replacing Post's basis-indexed positive-integer formulation by a modern productive-complement or many-one-completeness formulation would invent or substitute mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open in universe 0: the selected source must fix positive integers versus Nat, predicate versus Set Nat, the effective numbering of c.e. predicates, Post's basis or a checked modern index encoding, and every computability and decidability instance.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not select the definition, existence of a creative set, nonrecursiveness, complement infinitude, a closure property, a completeness characterization, or another property from Post's family.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; empty, universal, finite, malformed-index, duplicate-index, witness-outside-precondition, and positive-integer/Nat boundary cases remain statement tasks.
